evidence: The chemical bond states in the HfSi xOyNz buffer layers and HfO 2 / HfSixOyNz / Si structures were investigated with x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) using an Al Kα x-ray source. The thicknesses of the HfO 2 and interfacial layers were investigated by cross-sectional high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM). Capacitance-voltage (C – V) measurements were then performed using a Keithley 590 C – V analyzer at 100 kHz to investigate equivalent oxide thickness (EOT), flat band voltage, and effective fixed oxide charge density of the HfO 2 films.
